summary: Read-only audit of apps/app, packages/design, and packages/ui: enumerated source files, ran a PowerShell LOC sort, listed colocated tests, and read representative components/stores (SessionSidebar, Conversation, Composer, OnboardingDialog, SessionTree, ResourcesPanel, app-settings, ComponentGallery, PiExtensionUiStore, router, plus the design/ui packages' exports) to identify large files, mixed responsibilities, reuse opportunities, and current test layout. The transcript stops after the read phase; no refactor plan or phases were produced yet.
